item.summary: fix(config): diagnose an unwritable config directory instead of leaking EACCES (#127703) Every config write failed with a bare Node errno naming openclaw.json.lock when the config directory was not writable. The lock file is an internal artifact; the directory permissions are the actual problem, so operators were sent to investigate the wrong thing. withConfigMutationLock is the choke point for all config writes, so the diagnosis lands there once and every writer benefits. Only EACCES, EPERM, and EROFS whose reported path sits directly in the config directory are relabelled; the caller's mutation runs inside the same scope, so an unrelated permission error from its own work must keep propagating.
